qualification.details: Qualification: Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized Institution with at least 50% marks in the concerned subjects as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed. component; OR Bachelors/Honors degree from a recognized institution with at least 50% marks in concerned subject, combination of subjects as well as in the aggregate and B.Ed. degree from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks / three years integrated B.Ed-M.Ed. from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks / 01 year B.Ed.(Special Education) from RCI recognized institution with at least 50% marks; OR Post-Graduation in the concerned subject/specialization with minimum 55% marks, provided the candidate has studied the concerned subject at Graduation level; Qualified in CTET (Paper-II) conducted by the Government of India; Competence to teach through English & Hindi Medium; Candidate should have studied English as an elective/main subject in at least three years/6 semesters in graduation/four years integrated degree course Age limit: Maximum 50 years | Other conditions: | Qualified in CTET (Paper-II) conducted by the Government of India Competence to teach through English and Hindi medium English studied as an elective/main subject for at least three years/6 semesters in graduation or the integrated course | Desirable: | Teaching experience in a similar capacity in a recognized school Experience of working in a residential school Knowledge of regional languages Knowledge of computer application

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 34,125 per month; free food and accommodation at JNV Sambalpur

how_to_apply: Apply through physical mode only; no other mode of application is entertained.
Applications are received from 13.11.2026 to 19.11.2026 up to 05.00 PM.
Attend the walk-in interview on 20.11.2026 from 10.00 AM at PM Shri Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Goshala, Sambalpur, Odisha.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized Institution with at least 50% marks in the concerned subjects as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed. component; OR Bachelors/Honors degree from a recognized institution with at least 50% marks in concerned subject, combination of subjects as well as in the aggregate and B.Ed. degree from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks / three years integrated B.Ed-M.Ed. from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks / 01 year B.Ed.(Special Education) from RCI recognized institution with at least 50% marks; OR Post-Graduation in the concerned subject/specialization with minimum 55% marks, provided the candidate has studied the concerned subject at Graduation level; Qualified in CTET (Paper-II) conducted by the Government of India; Competence to teach through English & Hindi Medium; Candidate should have studied English as an elective/main subject in at least three years/6 semesters in graduation/four years integrated degree course Age limit: Maximum 50 years Other conditions: Qualified in CTET (Paper-II) conducted by the Government of India Competence to teach through English and Hindi medium English studied as an elective/main subject for at least three years/6 semesters in graduation or the integrated course Desirable: Teaching experience in a similar capacity in a recognized school Experience of working in a residential school Knowledge of regional languages Knowledge of computer application

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PM SHRI JNV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in PM SHRI JNV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for TGT (English).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for PM SHRI JNV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to PM SHRI Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Goshala, Sambalpur, Odisha 768025, by physical mode, to reach by 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 34,125 per month; free food and accommodation at JNV Sambalpur.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Four-year integrated degree from an NCTE-recognised institution with 50% marks, OR a Bachelor's/Honours degree with 50% marks and a B.Ed. (or an equivalent listed course) with 50% marks, OR a Post-Graduation in the concerned subject with 55% marks. Candidates also need CTET (Paper-II), competence to teach through English and Hindi medium, and English studied as an elective/main subject for at least 3 years/6 semesters.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Qualified in CTET (Paper-II) conducted by the Government of India. Competence to teach through English and Hindi medium. English studied as an elective/main subject for at least three years/6 semesters in graduation or the integrated course.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis for the academic year 2026-27. Period of contract up to 30.04.2027. Free food and accommodation will be provided at JNV, Sambalpur.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PM Shri JNV, Goshala, Sambalpur, Odisha.
